message.content:
This editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large white letters against a blue background, with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. At the top left, text reads "Selamat Datang Endemi H.26" next to a red rectangle. To the right, text reads "Bisnis Gurih Pay Later H.72". A barcode and QR code are in the top right corner. The main headline is "PANAS-DINGIN MINYAK GORENG", followed by a paragraph of Indonesian text.

The central artwork depicts two men in dark suits. The man on the left faces forward, holding a large yellow plastic cooking oil bottle horizontally. Liquid gold-colored particles spray from the bottle’s mouth onto his face. The man on the right is shown in profile, facing away from the center. He holds a similar yellow bottle pointed toward the first man, with more golden spray emitting from it. Both men have blue-toned skin and dark hair. The bottles have ribbed textures and rectangular shapes. The background is solid light blue. The composition focuses on the physical interaction between the figures and the spraying bottles.
